parameters.dialog-language: Russian unless controlling owner/project instructions select otherwise
parameters.model-mechanical: current inherited DSH model configuration; mechanical task classification recorded
parameters.model-routine: current inherited DSH model configuration; routine task classification recorded
parameters.model-judgment: current inherited DSH model configuration; hardest judgment requirement and actual capability assessed
parameters.gate-cadence: per-change exact specification; authentic approved batch scope where expressly granted; result gate separate

ask-owner-structured.mechanism: Use the native `ask_user_question` tool for the actual governing decision and retain the real action/artifact/scope provenance of the answer.
ask-owner-structured.fallback: Only an actual governing absent-mechanism case or an authentically authorized effective-undelivered session fallback, anchored by reason, authority and end trigger; expiry on structured delivery. No generic chat waiver.

plan-mode.mechanism: Use native plan mode when the session selects it; the plan leaves through `exit_plan_mode` and implementation begins only after approval.
plan-mode.fallback: Absent the mode: the root enforces design-only declared paths and no Code before the ready predicate; a behavioural boundary, never a hard-mode claim.

spawn-role-isolated.mechanism: The authorized parent uses the native `subagent` (provider `spawn`) or `subagent_fork` tool with a narrow self-contained role brief; a preset may register one distinctly configured delegation-tool instance per role with its own `persona`, `toolFilter` and `maxDepth`.
spawn-role-isolated.fallback: A child inherits the parent's preset revision and skill catalog, so per-call role scoping is unavailable: label sequential self-review and treat required independence as BLOCKED rather than inventing a worker.

model-tier.mechanism: Classify the hardest necessary step and use the inherited owner-configured model and effort; leave `agentOptions` provider/model/effort overrides unset without selection authority and record requested versus exposed observed facts.
model-tier.fallback: Where a child route is not selectable or observation is unavailable, the value stays unknown; no settings or provider mutation and no claimed model savings.

role-permissions.mechanism: The DSH sandbox mode and the per-instance `toolFilter.allow`/`deny` of a role delegation tool subtract tools from a child's prompt and refuse their execution; judges additionally treat original source and Git as read-only and use owned scratch without `.git`.
role-permissions.fallback: Where no role-scoped delegation tool is mounted, the role restriction is behavioural plus a root scope audit; disclose the gap instead of claiming enforcement.

pre-tool-guard.mechanism: The parent checks scope, authority, effects and denied commands before each operation, and reports a denied operation rather than retrying it another way.
pre-tool-guard.fallback: No executable hook is shipped by this package; a behavioural tripwire or manual audit cannot claim hard interception.

run-state-persist.mechanism: A single root writer uses `skills/feature-dev/scripts/run_state.py` schema 2, atomic UTF-8, under the target's `.methodology/runs/<run-id>/`, preserving accepted and refused history and current locks.
run-state-persist.fallback: An unreadable, corrupt or old-schema ledger blocks dependent continuation; no fabricated replacement and no silent reset or migration.

workflow-orchestration.mechanism: The explicitly authorized root dispatches and validates the native phases directly or through the `workflow` tool, and the helper applies its deterministic guards before an accepted record.
workflow-orchestration.fallback: No hidden daemon or model launcher; a missing required orchestration evidence is BLOCKED and inner roles never dispatch.

structured-output.mechanism: A role returns one full current canonical object; the parent performs extraction, type, conditional and semantic checks and the package wrapper preserves the result unchanged.
structured-output.fallback: Without a schema tool, actual JSON extraction plus manual validation with one bounded correction; JSON-looking prose alone is not enforcement.

skill-loading.mechanism: The DSH skill catalog exposes this package's `skills/` root and loads the named instruction body on demand; the parent may also supply exact resolved owner paths, and a complete current injection is accepted.
skill-loading.fallback: Path reads are allowed when the skill surface is absent; a missing, truncated, stale, stub or unread required body blocks, and no older cached copy substitutes for it.

rules-injection.mechanism: The parent supplies the full current six-core, role, runtime and target content, or the exact resolved paths with their identity and read conditions; DSH also loads project `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` chains on its own.
rules-injection.fallback: An assigned reader fetches any missing authoritative body; hashes, cards and summaries never satisfy full adoption.

session-start-hook.mechanism: The arriving parent or role performs an explicit Orient against the actual target records and the declared profile.
session-start-hook.fallback: This package installs no session-start hook; the assessment is manual, with its limits and artifacts recorded, and no silent-hook behaviour is claimed.

background-command.mechanism: Use the native job surface for a long authorized command and retain the job locator, complete streams and exit status.
background-command.fallback: A permitted bounded foreground run is acceptable when safe; disclose the absent background capacity and install no scheduler.

web-research.mechanism: Use the native web search and fetch tools for required external facts, preferring primary documentation for technical identifiers.
web-research.fallback: Missing access leaves a required claim unverified or BLOCKED; internal evidence is used only where it actually settles the claim.

browser.mechanism: Use an actually available browser or accessibility tool for an authorized runnable UI, and keep role, name and state readback separate from visual review.
browser.fallback: Component or controller tests within their true scope; an unavailable mandatory live-browser criterion remains BLOCKED, and no snapshot is invented.

worktree.mechanism: The root may obtain an authorized isolated implementation checkout that preserves existing dirt, with one writer per path.
worktree.fallback: An owned complete source copy or export is the fallback; judges cannot create worktrees or carry `.git`, and the isolation claim must match the observed mechanism.

schedule.mechanism: Only an explicit matching owner recurring-work request through the native scheduling tool.
schedule.fallback: No scheduling in the default package or smoke; a requested action is performed manually without claiming automatic follow-up.

memory.mechanism: Relevant project records and notes provide the pointers; an external knowledge source is used only when separately authorized, actually declared and available.
memory.fallback: External knowledge content stays external; no local engine, automatic curation or ingest is invented, and a no-match or access limit is reported honestly.

todo-list.mechanism: Track scoped task progress through `todo_write` and persist the durable record in the actual project plan or TASKS through the assigned writer.
todo-list.fallback: No extra tracker is required; inner actors return evidence to the custodian, and an absent tool does not waive the current records.

goal.mechanism: Only an explicit owner goal request through the native goal tools.
goal.fallback: An ordinary task outcome resides in the project task and plan records; no automatic tool goal is created and no revision field is invented.

code-map-build.mechanism: Run the actual target Doxyfile, tool and build, then inspect current covered source, config and full own XML and location output; the package map is separate.
code-map-build.fallback: A missing prerequisite is owed or BLOCKED; only an actual explicit written target prohibition is an exception, never a configured-only waiver.

check-runner.mechanism: Run permitted commands with exact plan argv, cwd and resources, and retain complete stdout, stderr, exit and log audit, plus direct logic and any real shipped CLI or artifact control.
check-runner.fallback: An unavailable required runtime proof is BLOCKED; command strings, capture and older results are not execution.

run-record-access.mechanism: Read the actual authorized immutable run artifacts, role originals, receipts, streams, state and identity chronology.
run-record-access.fallback: Missing or truncated access gaps stay explicit; do not reconstruct truth or zero costs from absence.

packaging-install.mechanism: Install this package as a DSH bundle into the selected profile and let it mount the package's own `skills/` root; the inventory, adapter, tests and maps are owned here.
packaging-install.fallback: A detached or global installation and a publication each require their own matching later decision; no installer and no discovery success is claimed in advance.

launch-environment.mechanism: The root names the actual allowed target, framework and evidence roots, the host permissions, autonomy, owned resources and the permitted credential-presence checks.
launch-environment.fallback: A missing granted write, tool or resource prerequisite blocks; no credential payload read, provider installation or shared teardown.

capability-discovery.mechanism: Read the actual exposed tool schemas, concurrency limits and permissions at entry and after each changed host condition.
capability-discovery.fallback: The adapter is a capability map only; no host API or observed mechanism is invented from availability.

context-management.mechanism: Keep sufficient relevant context and complete current required bodies, hand off stable artifacts and checkpoint in the same run before any continuation.
context-management.fallback: After compaction revalidate identities, evidence and ledger; fetch absent content, and never reset a run or budget or claim mental adoption.

tracker-integration.mechanism: Only an explicitly authorized actual tracker action, with source provenance retained.
tracker-integration.fallback: By default tasks remain in the actual TASKS and plan records; no external message or issue update follows from package adoption.
